# Shyam Kumar Yadav

> Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and Generative AI with 4+ years of experience designing, building, and owning production systems end-to-end — from database schema design to deployment and engineering team leadership.

## Projects & Systems

- [MyRelma — Multi-Tenant Career Coaching SaaS](https://its-sky-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Zero-to-production 27-module NestJS REST platform supporting 20+ tenant organizations at 99%+ uptime with Redis/BullMQ (10 queues) and CrewAI/Pinecone RAG assistant.
- [IMS Link — Enterprise Inventory Management System](https://its-sky-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Full-stack warehouse and inventory system with 30–40% API latency reduction, barcode scanning, and bidirectional sync for Intuitive ERP & Juki Fortress.
- [FlahyRecovery — Oncology Diagnostics Platform](https://its-sky-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Dual-API clinical backend on AdonisJS v6 with FHIR patient sync (200+ records), DICOM medical imaging service, Azure Blob Storage, and Twilio OTP.
- [IChooseIAM — Social Community & Event Platform](https://its-sky-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Event platform featuring event-scoped delegation RBAC, Incognito Mode pseudo-identity architecture, referral tracking, and real-time Socket.io/FCM alerts.
- [Gym Pilates — Fitness Class Booking Platform](https://its-sky-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): High-concurrency class booking platform with database concurrency control against double-bookings, Socket.io live availability, and bilingual i18n.
- [WalletApp — Multi-Wallet Expense Tracking API](https://its-sky-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): Multi-wallet financial tracking REST API with Sequelize aggregations, JWT/Bcrypt security, device fingerprinting, and automated email OTP resets.

## Core Technical Stack

- [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/): Primary typed programming language for enterprise APIs and web apps.
- [NestJS](https://nestjs.com/): Scalable Node.js framework used for microservices and modular REST APIs.
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/): Backend runtime for high-throughput asynchronous services.
- [Python & FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/): High-performance microservice framework for GenAI and RAG pipelines.
- [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/) & [MySQL](https://www.mysql.com/): Relational database engines with TypeORM, Prisma, and Sequelize.
- [Redis](https://redis.io/) & [BullMQ](https://bullmq.io/): Distributed caching, rate limiting, and 10 background job queues.
- [CrewAI](https://www.crewai.com/) & [Pinecone](https://www.pinecone.io/): Multi-agent AI task orchestration and vector retrieval-augmented generation.
- [Angular](https://angular.dev/) & [React](https://react.dev/): Responsive frontend client architectures.
